svg.text: Why Naive GF(2) Gauss-Jordan Breaks Reversibility vs. Bruhat LU:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Irreversible Trap: Zeroing M[j][i] ← M[j][i] ^ M[i][i] destroys the multiplier needed to

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: invert row operations on columns c > i, forcing O(r^2) out-of-place history qubits.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • In-Place Bruhat Solution: Apply CCX(M[j][i], M[i][c], M[j][c]) STRICTLY for c > i!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: The sub-diagonal entry M[j][i] remains intact as the lower-triangular factor L_{j,i},

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: while upper-triangular entries become U_{i,c}: P * M = L * U in place!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • AES MixColumns (r = 32): 0 ancilla qubits! Forward = L * U, Inverse = U^{-1} * L^{-1}.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Gate Count: r*(r-1)*(2r-1)/6 Toffolis for elimination + r*ceil(log2 r) pivot qubits.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • McEliece ISD: Replaces O(r*n) = 2,678,784 Q matrix allocation completely (see Panel b).
